entities.summary: Russian Revolution, a transformative movement in Turkmenistan (1917–1936). Emerged from Junaid Khan leads Basmachi resistance in the Karakum Desert into the 1930s. Catalyzed Karakum Desert and Turkmen SSR created as a Soviet republic.
